remarks: Location! Location! Location! This newly renovated one-bedroom, one bath condo features a large, bright living/dining room with hard wood floors that is flooded with natural light while showing off the open concept home. This chic space boasts an updated kitchen with granite counter tops and an eat-in breakfast area with a matching granite island. A spacious bedroom with hard wood floors and oversized closet space and a beautifully renovated bathroom with all new fixtures, tile floor and updated tile shower complete the ambience, making this home perfect for entertaining or relaxing after a long day. AND, there are new windows throughout! In addition, you'll be minutes away from fabulous restaurants in SONO, shopping at the SONO Mall, golf courses and the beach. Extra perks: Heat, hot water and an assigned parking space are included in the HOA. Conveniently located near Metro North Train and Bus Routes, Norwalk Hospital, Route 7 and I-95 this updated unit is a great opportunity to own your own home or build equity as an investment property.
